newsitem.title: USA: TransPro Inc Q1 net falls.
newsitem.headline: TransPro Inc Q1 net falls.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTES: The company recorded pre-tax costs of $810,000, or $0.07 a share, in Q1 1997 for announced actions to consolidate OEM and Aftermarket Heat Transfer organizations, to close New Haven OEM heavy duty heat transfer plant and to move the manufacturing to Jackson, Mississippi and to move Aftermarket heater manufacturing facility from Peru, Illinois, to Mexico.
Total cost of the actions is expected to be about $5.5 million pre-tax, about $5.2 million which has been incurred through March 31 and the remainder of which is to be expended in the second quarter.
1996 Q1 included $1,021,000 or $0.09 a share in pre-tax costs.
